title: MultiStageProtonScreen
description: A schema for the content of a multistage screen. Keep updated with any new/removed properties in MultiStageProtonScreen.jsx.

id.description: The unique identifier of the screen content. Each screen in a message should have a different ID, which can be referenced in actions to update the tour pref and advance screens.

force_hide_steps_indicator.description: If true, hides a series of dots that would show up at the bottom of the screen, indicating which screen the user is on. Defaults to false and will already be hidden if there's only one screen.

auto_dismiss.description: If present, the message is dismissed automatically once this screen has been shown for the given time. The countdown only runs while the page is visible, and starts over when the page becomes visible again. A card-stack message with transitions enabled plays its exit animation before it is dismissed. Screens are not dismissed automatically by default.

after.description: The time in milliseconds the screen is shown for before the message is dismissed.

anchors.description: An array of anchor objects. Each anchor object represents a single element on the page that the callout should be anchored to. The callout will be anchored to the first visible element in the array.

position.description: The layout position of the screen.

fullscreen.description: If true, the screens are displayed in fullscreen.

progress_bar.description: If true, the progress bar will be shown. Defaults to true.

background.description: The CSS background for the screen.

background_static.description: The static CSS background for the screen, provided if the default background has animated content.

hero_image.description: The hero image in the content.

url.description: The default URL of the hero image.

static_url.description: The URL of the static hero image, provided if the default hero image has animated content.

card_stack_image.description: The image to insert into the secondary section background if the screen is a card stack. 'Float' is the default and uses the 'background' property under the hood, so no extra URLs are needed.

type.description: The style of the image, which determines how it will fill the container and behave at breakpoints; 'float' is a centered floating image (default), 'bleed' is an image designed to bleed over the bottom edge of the card, and 'banner' is a wider image that will bleed over two edges, and convert to a centered image at smaller widths.

background_uncropped.description: The static CSS background to use with the 'bleed' image type.

background_medium.description: The static CSS background to use at the middle breakpoint with the banner image type.

background_small.description: The static CSS background to use at the smallest breakpoint with the banner image type.

label.description: The text to show next to the checkbox.

defaultValue.description: The default value of the checkbox.

action.description: The special message action invoked if the checkbox is selected.

label.description: The text to show inside the primary button.

action.description: The special message action invoked if the primary button is clicked.

has_arrow_icon.description: If true, shows an arrow icon next to the label.

disabled.description: If true, disables the button. If 'hasActiveMultiSelect', disables the button until the user selects something in the multiselect tiles. If 'hasTextInput', disables the button while the textarea tile is empty or exceeds the character limit. If 'hasActiveSingleSelect', disables the button until the user selects an option in the single-select tile. If set to 'hasPinnedSite', disables the button until the screen has had at least one successful pin.

style.description: Overrides the style of the button.

install_complete_label.description: The text for the RTAMO install button, provided in the primary button.

should_focus_button.description: If true, the primary button will be focused when the screen is displayed.

label.description: The text to show inside the secondary button.

action.description: The special message action invoked if the secondary button is clicked.

targeting.description: The JEXL targeting for conditional button display.

has_arrow_icon.description: If true, shows an arrow icon next to the label.

disabled.description: If true, disables the button. If 'hasActiveMultiSelect', disables the button until the user selects something in the multiselect tiles. If 'hasTextInput', disables the button while the textarea tile is empty or exceeds the character limit.

style.description: Overrides the style of the button.

text.description: Extra text to show before the button.

secondary_button_top.description: The secondary button(s) at the top of the screen.

label.description: The text to show inside the secondary button.

action.description: The special message action invoked if the secondary button is clicked.

targeting.description: The JEXL targeting for conditional button display.

oneOf.description: Use an array when there are multiple secondary buttons at the top of the screen.

label.description: The text to show inside the secondary button.

action.description: The special message action invoked if the secondary button is clicked.

targeting.description: The JEXL targeting for conditional button display.

label.description: The text to show inside the additional button.

action.description: The special message action invoked if the additional button is clicked.

disabled.description: If true, disables the button. If 'hasActiveMultiSelect', disables the button until the user selects something in the multiselect tiles. If 'hasTextInput', disables the button while the textarea tile is empty or exceeds the character limit.

style.description: Overrides the style of the button.

flow.description: If there are several buttons, this property can control the orientation of the buttons.

alignment.description: Justification and alignment of the buttons row/column. Defaults to 'end'.

label.description: Optionally used to control the aria attributes and tooltip.

action.description: The special message action invoked if the dismiss button is clicked.

size.description: The size of the button (20px, 24px, 32px). Defaults to 32px.

marginBlock.description: A CSS override for the marginBlock property.

marginInline.description: A CSS override for the marginInline property.

background.description: If true, adds a background to the dismiss button.

submenu_button.description: A submenu button that can be attached to another button.

label.description: Optionally used to control the aria label and can be used to override CSS styles.

style.description: Overrides the style of the button. Should be set to the same style as the button it's attached to.

attached_to.description: The button that the submenu split button is attached to.

submenu.description: The dropdown menu that appears when the user clicks the split button.

split_narrow_bkg_position.description: The background position for narrow split layouts.

autohide.description: If true, the callout hides on outside clicks.

width.description: The callout card width as a CSS value.

padding.description: The callout card padding as a CSS value.

layout.description: A layout variant for the screen. 'inline' is a single row layout that works well in tandem with title_logo. 'last-card' is the final card-stack screen, with the title and subtitle split around a centered image slot.

zap_border.description: If true, adds a colorful gradient border to the screen. This is only supported for screens with 'hide_arrow'. There is no effect if HCM or a custom theme add-on is enabled.

zap_shadow.description: If true, adds a colorful gradient shadow to the screen. This is only supported for screens with 'hide_arrow' and either 'absolute_position' or 'arrow_position'. There is no effect if HCM or a custom theme add-on is enabled.

zap_border_gradient.description: If present, a custom gradient to use in conjunction with the 'background' and 'zap_border' properties. Only applied if both other properties are present.

logo.description: An optional object representing a large illustration to show above other content.

darkModeReducedMotionImageURL.description: The dark mode reduced motion image URL.

videoURL.description: A video URL, played once, instead of the images above. Ignored (falls back to the image URLs above) for users who prefer reduced motion.

rtl.description: Right-to-left replacements for any of the URLs above, applied over them when the document is RTL. Omitted keys keep their base value.

width.description: The CSS style overriding the width property.

height.description: The CSS style overriding the height property.

marginBlock.description: The CSS style overriding the marginBlock property.

marginInline.description: The CSS style overriding the marginInline property.

style.description: The style of the image container.

imgStyle.description: More style overrides applied to the element.

center_image.description: An optional image shown in the center image slot of the 'last-card' layout, revealed once the text split animation completes.

darkModeReducedMotionImageURL.description: The dark mode reduced motion image URL.

rtl.description: Right-to-left replacements for any of the URLs above, applied over them when the document is RTL. Omitted keys keep their base value.

width.description: The CSS width of the image slot. The split animation and margins adapt to it. Defaults to 120px.

height.description: The CSS height of the image slot. Defaults to 120px.

marginBlock.description: The CSS style overriding the marginBlock property. Useful for aligning the image's focal point with the text. Does not apply on narrow breakpoints.

marginInline.description: The CSS style overriding the marginInline property. Does not apply on narrow breakpoints.

style.description: The style of the image container.

imgStyle.description: More style overrides applied to the element.

videoURL.description: A video URL, played once, instead of the images above. Ignored (falls back to the image URLs above) for users who prefer reduced motion.

corner_image.description: An optional object representing an illustration anchored to a corner of the screen. The fullscreen center-large layout anchors it to the window; every other layout anchors it to the card.

darkModeReducedMotionImageURL.description: The dark mode reduced motion image URL.

rtl.description: Right-to-left replacements for any of the URLs above, applied over them when the document is RTL. Omitted keys keep their base value.

position.description: The corner the illustration is anchored to. Defaults to 'bottom-right'. The -start/-end values are direction-relative and resolve against the text direction, so they mirror in RTL; the left/right values are always that physical corner.

width.description: The CSS style overriding the width property.

height.description: The CSS style overriding the height property.

marginBlock.description: The CSS style overriding the marginBlock property.

marginInline.description: The CSS style overriding the marginInline property.

style.description: CSS overrides applied to the illustration container. Avoid 'translate' and 'scale' when using 'entrance_animation', which animates those two properties and would be overridden by them. 'transform' is unaffected.

entrance_animation.description: How the illustration animates in each time the screen is entered. The direction is derived from 'position', so a 'bottom-left' illustration rises and a 'top-left' one descends. Every type degrades to an opacity-only fade for users who prefer reduced motion.

type.description: The animation to run. Defaults to 'none'.

distance.description: The CSS length the illustration travels, for the 'slide-*' types.

duration.description: The CSS time the animation takes.

delay.description: The CSS time to wait before starting, for staggering the illustration against the screen's other content.

title_logo.description: An optional object representing an icon to show next to the title.

darkModeReducedMotionImageURL.description: The dark mode reduced motion image URL.

rtl.description: Right-to-left replacements for any of the URLs above, applied over them when the document is RTL. Omitted keys keep their base value.

width.description: The CSS style overriding the width property.

height.description: The CSS style overriding the height property.

marginBlock.description: The CSS style overriding the marginBlock property.

marginInline.description: The CSS style overriding the marginInline property.

alignment.description: The logo alignment relative to the title.

style.description: The style of the image container.

imgStyle.description: More style overrides applied to the element.

videoURL.description: A video URL, played once, instead of the images above. Ignored (falls back to the image URLs above) for users who prefer reduced motion.

subtitle.description: The text to show below the title.

above_button_content.description: An extra block of configurable content below the title/subtitle but above the main buttons. Can be placed above the 'tiles' by setting 'tiles_container.position' to 'after_supporting_content'.

type.description: The type of content.

link_keys.description: A list of the link keys that exist in screen.content. The value of that key must be an object with an 'action' property and the 'string_id' in the 'text' object must refer to a Fluent string that contains an anchor element with `data-l10n-name='LINK_KEY_NAME'`.

steps_indicator.description: Optionally used to override the aria attributes or tooltip of the steps indicator. Not recommended.

tiles.description: Tile object(s) to display on the screen, rendered in ContentTiles.jsx.

position.description: The position of the tiles container relative to supporting content like 'above_button_content'. By default, it comes before the supporting content.

tiles_header.description: The header for a tiles container.

reverse_split.description: If true, applies the reverse split layout onto the screen (i.e., inverts the visual order of the split screens).

main_content_style.description: CSS overrides for the main content style on wide screens.

main_content_style_narrow.description: CSS overrides for the main content style on narrow screens.

split_content_justify_content.description: A CSS override allowing custom justify content on split screens.

action_buttons_above_content.description: If true, displays action buttons above main content.

has_noodles.description: If true, adds noodle illustrations that peek out behind the screen.

narrow.description: If true, sets the narrow attribute on the outer element of the screen.

languageSwitcher.description: The language switcher component that appears if there is a language mismatch screen.

video_url.description: The URL of the video to play.

autoPlay.description: If true, autoplay is enabled for the video.

text_color.description: Overrides all text color on the screen.

isSystemPromptStyleSpotlight.description: If true, overrides the Spotlight screen styling to look like the system prompt style.

screen_style.description: CSS overrides for the screen style.

no_rdm.description: If true, prevents the Spotlight from entering responsive design mode at widths less than 800px.

split_content_padding_block.description: The CSS override for the paddingBlock styling for split layout contents.

split_content_padding_inline.description: The CSS override for the paddingInline styling for split layout contents.

cta_paragraph.description: Text below the subtitle that can include hyperlinks.

string_id.description: The Fluent string id for the paragraph text.

string_name.description: The name of the `` marker inside the string_id.

info_tile.description: If true, applies the info-tile styling to the CTA paragraph.

icon.description: The icon to be displayed next to the CTA text.

style.description: CSS overrides for the CTA paragraph.

info_text.description: Info text displayed at the bottom of the screen.

isEncryptedBackup.description: If true, displays the encrypted backup method as part of the 'fx_backup_file_path' or 'fx_backup_password' tile type.

migrate_start.description: The action for the migration start event as part of the embedded migration wizard component within about:welcome.

migrate_close.description: The action for the migration close event as part of the embedded migration wizard component within about:welcome.

page_event_listeners.description: An optional array of event listeners to add to the page where the screen is shown.

type.description: The event type string. Supports any DOM event type, timeout and interval for timers, and internal feature callout events 'touradvance' and 'tourend'.

capture.description: If true, handles events in the capture phase.

once.description: If true, removes the listener after the first event.

preventDefault.description: If true, prevents the default action in the event handler.

every_window.description: If true, adds the listener to all windows.

impression_action.description: A special message action that fires automatically when the screen is first shown.

dismiss_action.description: An action to perform when the Escape key is pressed, or when a page event listener invokes an action containing `dismiss: true`. Unnecessary if your message has a dismiss_button.

ignorekeys.description: By default, hitting Escape will dismiss the callout, whether it is focused or not. Setting this to true will stop keypresses from dispatching up to the callout from outside it, though they will still work when the callout is focused. Best to leave this as-is.

isRtamo.description: Set to true for RTAMO screens in about:welcome.

backdrop.description: The CSS backdrop for the content.

localizableThing.description: Text that can be a raw string or have a Fluent string_id.

raw.description: A raw, untranslated string (typically used for EN-only experiments) or an $l10n object.

id.description: A unique identifier for the string. It can only contain letters, numbers, and hyphens (-).

comment.description: A comment used to provide more context to localizers.

string_id.description: Fluent string identifier from a .ftl file.

args.description: Arguments for Fluent strings that have variables.

aria_label.description: A string to use as the element's aria-label attribute value.

useLangPack.description: If true, uses the installed lang pack for the Fluent strings.

inline_icons.description: Inline icons inside localized strings. Each entry maps a Fluent data-l10n-name to an icon object.

selector.description: A CSS selector for the element to anchor to.

panel_position.description: Represents how the callout should be positioned relative to the anchor element.

anchor_attachment.description: The point on the anchor that the callout should be tied to.

callout_attachment.description: The point on the callout that should be tied to the anchor.

flip.description: The flip behavior to apply to the panel when it would overflow the screen. 'slide' makes the panel slide in the direction it's overflowing, to keep it on screen. If it overflows in the same direction it's aligned relative to the anchor, it will flip in that direction. 'none' just allows the panel to bleed out of bounds, without flipping or sliding.

offset_x.description: Offsets in pixels to apply to the callout position in the horizontal direction.

offset_y.description: Offsets in pixels to apply to the callout position in the vertical direction.

hide_arrow.description: If true, hides the arrow that points from the callout to the anchor.

no_open_on_anchor.description: If true, skips applying the [open] style to the anchor element when the callout is shown.

arrow_width.description: The width of the arrow in pixels. Defaults to 33.94113 (which corresponds to a triangle with 24px edges).

arrow_corner_distance.description: The distance between the arrow and the corner of the parent box element in pixels. Defaults to 12px.

autofocus.description: Allows you to force an element inside the callout to be focused when the callout is shown.

selector.description: A preferred CSS selector, if you want a specific element to be focused.

use_defaults.description: If 'selector' is provided and the element can't be found, and this is set to false, nothing will be focused. If 'selector' is not provided, this must be true. Defaults to true.

dismiss.description: If true, dismisses the screen. Can be used in addition to or instead of a special message action type. If set to 'actionResult', the callout will only be dismissed after the special message action has resolved successfully, will only take effect for certain special message ids, and requires setting 'needsAwait' to true.

needsAwait.description: If true, the action needs to be awaited. Must be true if 'dismiss' is set to 'actionResult'.

navigate.description: If true, navigates to the next step.

goBack.description: If true, goes back to the previous step.

collectSelect.description: If true, the actions for selected checkbox/radio selections are performed in series. Set to true if this action is for the primary button and the 'multiselect' tile is used.

collectContentToggleState.description: If true, collects content toggle state on action.

direction.description: How many screens and in which direction to advance. Positive integers advance forward while negative integers advance backward.

sendDismissTelemetry.description: If true, sends dismiss telemetry when the action is performed.

reposition.description: page_event_listeners actions only. If true, repositions the callout.

once.description: If true, only fires on the screen's first view.

picker.description: For tile actions only. '<event>' handles the selected element's value as a picker selection.

persistActiveTheme.description: For tile actions only. If true, saves the active theme as the initial theme to revert to.

data.description: Tile configurations needed for the tile type. Using this tile type requires a `write_in_microsurvey: true` inside the message content to apply the write-in microsurvey data policy. This is REQUIRED for all write-in microsurveys. Messages using the textarea tile should always set this to true. It prevents `client_id` from being recorded with any telemetry events for the message, recording a unique `impression_id` instead. It also sends the events on the `microsurvey` ping instead of the `messaging-system` ping, which is anonymized by OHTTP, has stricter access control, and is retained for a shorter period. It still allows counting unique impressions and joining pings from the same message, but it can't be joined to any other telemetry data. So all events coming from a message with this set to true will be joinable by `impression_id`, but disconnected from other datasets. Optional; defaults to false if omitted.

source.description: Where the tile draws its sites from. 'curated' (the default) uses the authored 'data' array. 'topFrecentSites' replaces it with the user's own most-used origins, computed locally from history. Currently only supported in Spotlight.

slots.description: How many tiles the surface shows. Defaults to 5.

minPersonalized.description: Only when source is 'topFrecentSites'. The fewest personalized origins the tile must produce for the message to be shown at all. When the user's history yields fewer, the message is withheld and records no impression. Defaults to 0, which permits an entirely backfilled, curated tile. A value above 'slots' always withholds the message, as does a tile left with no sites at all.

backfill.description: When personalization yields fewer origins than 'slots', fill the remaining slots from the authored 'data' array rather than leaving them blank. Defaults to true.

pinButtonLabel.description: A label for an optional pin button.

alwaysShowPinButton.description: If true, applies the always-visible styling on the pinnable sites list.
